issue.title: Problem with Pytest 2.8 and Django settings
issue.body:
After update to Pytest 2.8 my tests started failing.

The problem is that when I configure Django setings in `conftest.py`:

``` py
from django.conf import settings

def pytest_configure():
    settings.configure(DATABASES=...)
```

Pytest 2.8 tries to read some properties from `settings` before they're configured and it raises an error. So I have to do some workaround to make it work:

``` py
from django import conf

def pytest_configure():
    conf.settings.configure(DATABASES=...)
```

It's a problem of `pytest`, not `pytest-django`. But I think you could mention this workaround in your documentation.

body: Is this a bug in pluggy?
@pelme yes, the workflow for fixing is fixing in pluggy, doing a pluggy release and then vendoring that pluggy release into pytest

issue.body:
I have this problem: https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-django/issues/272

But it's not a bug of `pytest-django`, it caused by new Pytest 2.8 behaviour. I have `conftest.py`:

``` py
from django.conf import settings

def pytest_configure():
    settings.configure(...)
```

Pytest 2.8 is trying to read properties of `settings` variable before Django is configured. This causes an error. I can do some workaround, but is it the correct way to solve it?
